field.defaultValue: replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(rtrim(a.i_error), rtrim(r0.ccode), r0.cname%l + ' '), rtrim(r1.ccode), r1.cname%l + ' '), rtrim(r2.ccode), r2.cname%l + ' '), rtrim(r3.ccode), r3.cname%l + ' '), rtrim(r4.ccode), r4.cname%l + ' ')

command.text: declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &VisibleFieldGridShowing; select @message as message return

action.text: &CreateTicket; if not exists(select 1 from c15$000000 where stt_rec = @stt_rec) begin select @ticket as value, '' as id return end declare @filename varchar(128), @description nvarchar(128) select @filename = rtrim(stt_rec) + convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + '.xml', @description = @stt_rec from c15$000000 where stt_rec = @stt_rec update @@sysDatabaseName..ticket set filename = @filename, description = @description where ticket = @keyTicket select @ticket as value, @@userID as id return

declare @status nvarchar(512) select @status = rtrim(case when @@language = 'v' then ten_tt else ten_tt2 end) from @@sysDatabaseName..dmttdkt where ma_tt = @ma_tt select isnull(@status, '') as status return
select case when count(unit_code) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as value from mailboxserver where status = 1 return

declare @authorize int select @authorize = rtrim(@@sysDatabaseName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetAuthorize(@@admin, @@userID, @controller, 'New')) if @authorize <> 1 begin select 'NotAuthorize' as value return end exec dbo.rs_GetInputInvoiceData @stt_rec, @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, @ma_ct, '&Customer.Code;', '&Item.Code;', @@unit, @@language, @@userID, @@admin return

select * into #sttRec from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@sttRec, ',') select * into #date from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ngay_ct, ',')
declare @q nvarchar(4000), @i int, @n int, @stt_rec varchar(13), @ngay smalldatetime, @w nvarchar(4000) select @i = 1, @w = '', @n = count(*) from #sttRec
if '&Customer.Code;' <> '' and @@admin = 0 exec FastBusiness$System$GetUnitFilter @@unit, @@userID, @@admin, 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ma_dvcs', 'a.ds_dvcs', 'dmkhdv', @w output
create table #err (error tinyint, invalid varchar(32)) create table #kh (ma_kh varchar(32), ten_kh nvarchar(512), tk varchar(32), ten_tk nvarchar(512), mst varchar(32))
while @i <= @n begin select @stt_rec = replace(data, '''', '') from #sttRec where id = @i select @ngay = replace(data, '''', '') from #date where id = @i
select @q = ' declare @status char(1), @statusBatch char(1), @taxCode varchar(32), @customer varchar(32), @customerName nvarchar(512), @account varchar(32), @accountName nvarchar(512) select @status = status, @statusBatch = tt_gs, @taxCode = mst_cn from m15$%Partition where %[stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''']% if @status = ''4'' or @status = ''*'' begin select 1 as error, '''' as invalid return end if @statusBatch = ''2'' begin select 2 as error, '''' as invalid return end
select top 1 @customer = rtrim(a.ma_kh), @customerName = case when '@@language' = ''V'' then a.ten_kh else a.ten_kh2 end, @account = rtrim(a.tk), @accountName = case when '@@language' = ''V'' then b.ten_tk else b.ten_tk2 end from dmkh a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.ma_so_thue = @taxCode and a.cc_yn = 1 ' + case when @w = '' then '' else ' and ' + @w end + ' order by a.status desc, a.datetime2 desc
if isnull(@customer, '''') = '''' and (select count(distinct mst) from #kh) > 1 begin select 3 as error, @taxCode as invalid return end else insert into #kh select isnull(@customer, ''''), isnull(@customerName, ''''), isnull(@account, ''''), isnull(@accountName, ''''), @taxCode ' insert into #err exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @ngay, @ngay, @@userID, @@admin if exists(select 1 from #err) begin select top 1 error, invalid from #err return end
set @i = @i + 1 end
if @quick = 1 begin if exists(select 1 from #kh where isnull(ma_kh, '') = '') and (select count(distinct mst) from #kh) > 1 begin select top 1 3 as error, mst as invalid from #kh where isnull(ma_kh, '') = '' return end if (select count(distinct mst) from #kh) = 1 select top 1 '-1' as error, ma_kh, ten_kh, tk, ten_tk, mst from #kh else select '-1' as error, '' as ma_kh, '' as ten_kh, '' as tk, '' as ten_tk, '' as mst return end
select 0 as value return

declare @q nvarchar(4000), @i int, @n int, @voucherID varchar(32), @voucherDate smalldatetime, @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$used nvarchar(512), @listVoucherID varchar(32)
select @id = replace(replace(@id, char(252), ''''), '''', '''''') select @date = replace(replace(@date, char(252), ''''), '''', '''''') select * into #id from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@id, ',') select * into #date from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@date, ',') select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'V' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end select @$used = case when @@language = 'V' then N'Hóa đơn đã phát sinh, không thể xóa được.' else N'Cannot delete the invoice. It has already been used.' end
create table #err (message nvarchar(4000)) create table #lockedDate (r int) create table #pdf (filePdf varchar(64))
-- Checking select @i = 1, @n = count(*) from #id while @i <= @n begin select @voucherID = replace(data, '''', '') from #id where id = @i select @voucherDate = replace(data, '''', '') from #date where id = @i
select @q = ' declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32), @ownerID int, @fullDelete bit, @$checkVoucherLockedDate smalldatetime, @$checkVoucherUnit varchar(32)
select @$checkVoucherHandle = status, @ownerID = user_id0, @$checkVoucherLockedDate = ngay_ct, @$checkVoucherUnit = ma_dvcs from i15$%Partition where stt_rec = %[''' + @voucherID + ''']%
if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = ''E05'' and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xdel = 1) begin insert into #err values(''$NotAuthorized'') return end if @@admin <> 1 begin if (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = ''E05'' and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = ''E05'' and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin insert into #err values(''$NotAuthorized'') return end if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = ''E05'' and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_del = 1) begin insert into #err values(''$NotAuthorized'') return end end if @ownerID <> @@userID begin exec @@sysDatabaseName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetShareAccess ''E05'', @@userID, @@admin, 2, @fullDelete output if (@fullDelete = 0) begin insert into #err values(''$NotAuthorized'') return end end end if @$checkVoucherLockedDate is not null begin insert into #lockedDate exec fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher ''E05'', @$checkVoucherLockedDate, @@userID, @$checkVoucherUnit, 1 if not exists(select * from #lockedDate where r = 1) begin insert into #err values(N''' + @$lockedDate + ''') delete #lockedDate return end end if @@admin <> 1 begin if not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_dvcs = @$checkVoucherUnit and r_del = 1) begin insert into #err values(''$NotAuthorized'') return end end if @$checkVoucherHandle = ''4'' or @$checkVoucherHandle = ''*'' begin insert into #err values(N''' + @$used + ''') return end ' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @voucherDate, @voucherDate, @@userID, @@admin
if exists(select 1 from #err) begin select top 1 1 as error, message from #err return end
set @i = @i + 1 end
-- Delete select @listVoucherID = '''' + replace(@id, ',', ''', ''') + '''' select @dateFrom = replace(replace(@dateFrom, char(252), ''''), '''', '''''') select @dateTo = replace(replace(@dateTo, char(252), ''''), '''', '''''')
select @q = ' insert into #pdf select convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + stt_rec from m15$%Partition where %[stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')]%
delete i15$%Partition where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')&VoucherLogKey; delete d15$%Partition where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')&VoucherLogKey; delete c15$000000 where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')&VoucherLogKey; delete x15$%Partition where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')&VoucherLogKey; delete e15$%Partition where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ')&VoucherLogKey; delete t15$%Partition where stt_rec_hd in(' + @listVoucherID + ')
if &UsedVoucherLog; = 1 begin update m15$%Partition set status = ''*'', user_id2 = @@userID, datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ') update i15$%Partition set status = ''*'' where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ') update c15$000000 set status = ''*'' where stt_rec in(' + @listVoucherID + ') end ' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @@userID, @@admin
declare @invoke nvarchar(4000), @$filePdf varchar(max) if exists(select 1 from #pdf) begin select @$filePdf = stuff((select '|' + filePdf from #pdf for xml path(''), type).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') select 0 as error, '' as message, 'ConvertXmlExtender.ConvertXmlExtender.DeleteAttachmentPdfFile(,' + @$filePdf + ')' as invoke end else select 0 as error, '' as message return
